title: Most Broncos’ fans hope to see a big trade before free agency

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Most Broncos’ fans hope to see a big trade before free agency
sources.description: According to our FanDuel SB Nation Reacts survey this week, 57% of Denver Broncos fans hope to see a big trade by the team before free agency. The frame-up to that question was a trade for another player or a trade of one of their own. So really, any type of big-time trade. While legal […]
